chain_augmentations: chain multiple data augmentation functions sequentially on a MiniBatch example
normalize_images: normalize image pixel values to the -1 to 1 range and convert grayscale to RGB
central_crop_and_resize: extract the central region of an image and resize it to a given size
random_crop_and_resize: randomly sample a distorted crop from an image and resize it to a given size
standardize_per_image: standardize each image by subtracting the mean and dividing by the standard deviation
